words.def: a short list of the main points of something, without the details.
words.book: Here's a brief outline of what we'll be covering today.
uses: Email
Please find below a brief outline of the proposed maintenance plan.
Chat
can u send me a rough outline of the pitch before tmrw?
Meeting
Here's a quick outline of the solar project phases.
dont: I will give you the headlines of the topics.
doo: Here's a brief outline of today's topics.

words.def: to deal with a problem or question and try to solve it.
words.book: I'll begin by discussing the challenges that organizations face in project management and how our training course can help address them.
uses: Email
Our engineer will visit on Sunday to address the battery alarm issue.
Chat
did anyone address the client's complaint about the invoice?
Meeting
Our new service contract addresses the main concerns you raised last month.
dont: We will solve for the problem of the batteries.
doo: We will address the battery issue.

words.def: to finish a meeting, presentation or task.
words.book: Finally, I'll wrap up with information on how to enroll in the course and answer any questions you may have.
uses: Email
We aim to wrap up the site survey by Thursday and send the quotation on Sunday.
Chat
let's wrap up, I have a call at 3
Meeting
Before we wrap up, let's agree on the next steps.

words.def: used only for one particular purpose or person.
words.book: If you could hold your questions until the end, we'll have a dedicated Q&A session where we can discuss any questions you may have.
uses: Email
Your account will have a dedicated service engineer available 24/7.
Chat
do we have a dedicated person for the bank's UPS sites?
Meeting
We've set up a dedicated team for data-centre projects.
dont: We will put an engineer special for you.

words.def: the final result of an action, process or meeting.
words.book: In this presentation, John will provide an overview of the course objectives, content and outcomes, as well as information on how to enroll.
uses: Email
I'll share the outcome of the site inspection by end of day.
Chat
any outcome from the meeting with purchasing?
Meeting
The expected outcome is zero downtime during the battery replacement.
dont: What is the result of the meeting?
doo: What was the outcome of the meeting?

words.def: to feel happy about something that is going to happen.
words.book: I'm looking forward to sharing with you what we do here.
uses: Email
We look forward to working with you on the Alexandria project.
Chat
looking forward to the demo tmrw 🙌
Meeting
I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback on the proposal.
goes: look forward to hearing from you
look forward to working with you
dont: I am looking forward to hear from you.
doo: I look forward to hearing from you.

pro: Thank you for taking the time to join us today.
upgrade.why: ‎taking the time‎ بتقدّر وقتهم، وده أنسب لافتتاح عرض.

upgrade.plain: I will talk to you about the new UPS.
pro: The objective of today's presentation is to introduce our new UPS range.
I will speak you about the new UPS.
Today I talk on the new UPS.
upgrade.why: حدد الهدف من الأول: ‎The objective of today's presentation is to …‎

upgrade.plain: At the end you will understand everything.
pro: In the end you will understand all.
After finish, everything will be clear.
By the end of this presentation, you will have a clear understanding of our service plans.
upgrade.why: ‎By the end of this presentation‎ = وعد واضح للجمهور باللي هيطلعوا بيه.

upgrade.plain: I divided the presentation for three parts.
pro: I divided the presentation for three parts.
I'll be breaking the presentation down into three parts.
upgrade.why: ‎break down into‎ هي الطريقة الطبيعية لتقسيم العرض.

upgrade.plain: I will not take a long time from you.
pro: I know everyone's time is valuable, so I'll keep it brief.
I will not take long time from you.
upgrade.why: «مش هطوّل» بتتقال ‎I'll keep it brief‎، ومتترجمهاش حرفي.

upgrade.plain: Don't ask now, wait to the end.
pro: Don't ask now, wait the end.
Wait to the end for questions.
If you could hold your questions until the end, we'll have a Q&A session.
upgrade.why: ‎If you could hold …‎ طلب مؤدب بدل الأمر المباشر.
